blocks.title: Appetite: Seldom Stirred
blocks.content:
Desire is a rare visitor. Long stretches pass without it, and they do not notice the time.

**Characteristics**

- Closeness and touch matter; wanting more than that seldom follows
- Finds other people's preoccupation with it faintly puzzling
- When it does come, it is unmistakable, because it is unusual
- Not a lack, not a wound, and not something to be fixed

blocks.title: Appetite: Slow to Kindle
blocks.content:
Desire is there, but it builds rather than strikes. It needs time, ease and the right company before it shows itself.

**Characteristics**

- Rarely wants out of nowhere; usually wants in answer to something
- Worry, hurry or distraction put it out before it catches
- Once kindled, burns as steadily as anyone's

blocks.title: Appetite: As Much as Most
blocks.content:
Desire comes and goes with the days - stronger when life is easy, quieter when it is not.

**Characteristics**

- Rises with rest and good company, fades under strain
- Notices an attractive stranger, and moves on
- Would call themselves neither cold nor hungry

blocks.title: Appetite: Easily Stirred
blocks.content:
Desire sits close to the surface and does not take much to wake. A look, a touch, the right voice, and it is there.

**Characteristics**

- Notices bodies, and knows they are noticing
- Thoughts drift that way in idle moments
- Wanting someone and choosing them are separate things to them

blocks.title: Appetite: Runs Hot
blocks.content:
Desire is a near-constant undercurrent - a large part of how they meet the world, and seldom far from mind.

**Characteristics**

- Thinks about it often, and without needing a reason
- Goes without it poorly, and notices the lack
- Hunger decides how often they want; it has never decided whom

blocks.title: Stirred By: Competence
blocks.content:
Watching someone do a difficult thing well - a clean kill, a lock giving way, a blade finished at the forge.

**Characteristics**

- Notices how a thing was done, not only that it was done
- Effortless mastery affects them more than effort

blocks.title: Stirred By: Strength
blocks.content:
Physical power - a body built by labour or war, and the ease of someone who carries what others cannot.

**Characteristics**

- Notices shoulders, hands, the way someone lifts
- Being steadied or lifted without effort lands hard

blocks.title: Stirred By: Beauty
blocks.content:
A face and form, plainly. The most ordinary pull there is, and they do not pretend otherwise.

**Characteristics**

- Looks first, learns the rest later
- Knows the difference between wanting someone and liking them

blocks.title: Stirred By: A Sharp Mind
blocks.content:
Learning and cleverness - someone who knows things, reasons well, and can win an argument.

**Characteristics**

- Being out-argued excites more than it insults
- Talk of books, history or strategy holds them

blocks.title: Stirred By: Wit
blocks.content:
Banter. Being made to laugh, and being answered in kind.

**Characteristics**

- A quick reply does more than a compliment
- Teasing is a form of courtship to them

blocks.title: Stirred By: Confidence
blocks.content:
Someone at ease in themselves, who fills a room without trying.

**Characteristics**

- Certainty draws them; arrogance is not the same thing
- Notices who others turn to when a decision is needed

blocks.title: Stirred By: Power and Standing
blocks.content:
Titles, wealth, influence - a name people lower their voices for.

**Characteristics**

- Notices who defers to whom
- A Jarl's favour or a guild's respect does more than a gift

blocks.title: Stirred By: Magic
blocks.content:
Real power in someone's hands - spellcraft done well, the air changing when it is cast.

**Characteristics**

- Watches spellwork the way others watch a dancer
- The more effortless the casting, the stronger the pull

blocks.title: Stirred By: Scars
blocks.content:
A body that has been through things and shows it. Every mark is a story they want told.

**Characteristics**

- Asks about scars rather than looking away
- Smooth, unmarked skin says little to them

blocks.title: Stirred By: A Hint of Danger
blocks.content:
A reputation, a capacity for violence that others are wary of. Someone who could do harm, and chooses where.

**Characteristics**

- The wariness in other people's eyes is part of the attraction
- Draws closer to what others step back from

blocks.title: Stirred By: Kindness to Others
blocks.content:
Gentleness from someone capable of harm - care shown to children, animals, the hurt and the poor.

**Characteristics**

- Notices how someone treats those who can do nothing for them
- A small unseen kindness moves them more than a grand gesture

blocks.title: Stirred By: Voice
blocks.content:
How someone speaks - the pitch, the pace, the way a name is said. For a rare few, the Thu'um itself.

**Characteristics**

- Listens to the voice as much as the words
- Being spoken to softly, close, affects them more than touch

blocks.title: Stirred By: The Rush After a Fight
blocks.content:
Alive afterwards, with the fight still in the blood. Surviving together wakes something the calm never does.

**Characteristics**

- The heat comes after the danger, never during it
- A near thing wakes it; an easy fight does not
- Fades within the hour if nothing comes of it

blocks.title: Stirred By: Drink and Revelry
blocks.content:
Mead, music, a loud hall and loosened rules. Celebration lowers their guard and raises everything else.

**Characteristics**

- A feast or a tavern night is when they are most open
- A cup or two, not a drunk - past that it goes the other way

blocks.title: Stirred By: Safety and Warmth
blocks.content:
A barred door, a fire, a full belly. Desire only comes when nothing is wrong.

**Characteristics**

- An inn room or a home of their own does what no campsite can
- Has to stop being watchful before they can want anything

blocks.title: Stirred By: The Open Wild
blocks.content:
Hot springs, starlight, miles from anyone. The world far away and no walls anywhere.

**Characteristics**

- More at ease under the sky than under a roof
- A quiet camp away from the road is when they are most open

blocks.title: Stirred By: Secrecy
blocks.content:
The risk of being found, the thing they should not want. What is hidden is sweeter to them.

**Characteristics**

- A stolen moment means more than an evening freely given
- Being openly claimed may cool them rather than warm them

blocks.title: Stirred By: The Unfamiliar
blocks.content:
New places, new people, first times. Novelty wakes them the way routine never will.

**Characteristics**

- Most open somewhere they have never been
- The same room every night slowly dulls them

blocks.title: Stirred By: Exertion
blocks.content:
Their own body's heat - after sparring, a hard climb, a day's labour. A body used hard wakes up.

**Characteristics**

- Most aware of themselves when they are breathing hard
- Sparring with the right person can turn into something else

blocks.title: Stirred By: Being Wanted
blocks.content:
Desire that follows being desired rather than coming first. Knowing they are wanted is what wakes it.

**Characteristics**

- Rarely wants first; answers wanting with wanting
- Uncertain interest does little; unmistakable interest does a great deal
- Being wanted is not the same as being pressed

blocks.title: Stirred By: Being Known
blocks.content:
Long talk, confidences kept, being understood. Desire follows closeness of mind, never the other way round.

**Characteristics**

- A conversation that goes deep can do what a body cannot
- Nothing stirs for someone they do not yet know well

blocks.title: Stirred By: Being Protected
blocks.content:
Someone stepping between them and harm. Being kept safe by another's hand wakes something.

**Characteristics**

- Remembers who stood in front of them, and when
- Being shielded without having to ask lands hardest

blocks.title: Stirred By: Being Needed
blocks.content:
Being relied upon. Caring for someone, being the one they turn to.

**Characteristics**

- Tending a wound can become something tender
- Being sought out matters more than being thanked

blocks.title: Stirred By: Tenderness
blocks.content:
Slowness and care. Being handled gently, without hurry.

**Characteristics**

- A patient touch does more than a bold one
- Roughness or haste closes them up at once

blocks.title: Stirred By: Yielding
blocks.content:
Handing the decision to someone they trust, and being led. Given freely, never taken.

**Characteristics**

- Being told what happens next, by someone they chose, is a relief
- The choice to yield is always theirs, and they know it

blocks.title: Stirred By: Taking the Lead
blocks.content:
Setting the pace and being followed. Deciding what happens next is part of the pleasure.

**Characteristics**

- Likes to be the one who begins it
- Watches to see whether they will be followed

blocks.title: Stirred By: Rivalry
blocks.content:
Contest, sparring, being matched or beaten. Friction is a kind of spark to them.

**Characteristics**

- A worthy opponent draws more interest than an admirer
- Losing a fair contest can do as much as winning one

blocks.title: Stirred By: Vulnerability
blocks.content:
Seeing someone strong unguarded - wounded, grieving, afraid. Being trusted with weakness moves them.

**Characteristics**

- An admitted fear brings them closer than a victory
- Would never use what they are shown against anyone

blocks.title: Stirred By: Reunion
blocks.content:
Coming back after time apart. Absence sharpens what routine had dulled.

**Characteristics**

- The first evening back is when they are most open
- Being missed, and hearing it said, matters to them

blocks.title: Stirred By: The End of a Quarrel
blocks.content:
The heat that comes when a fight between them finally breaks. Making up is its own kind of closeness.

**Characteristics**

- Only once it is truly over; not while anything is unresolved
- Anger that is aired does this; anger that festers does not

blocks.title: Stirred By: Honour
blocks.content:
Doing right when it costs something. Integrity under pressure moves them.

**Characteristics**

- Remembers a kept promise longer than a gift
- Watches what someone does when doing wrong would be easier

blocks.title: Stirred By: Ruthlessness
blocks.content:
Doing what has to be done without flinching. Hard decisions made cleanly draw them.

**Characteristics**

- Sentiment where resolve was needed disappoints them
- Respects whoever does the necessary thing, even an ugly one

blocks.title: Cooled By: An Audience
blocks.content:
Others nearby. Whatever they feel stays put away while anyone else could see or hear.

**Characteristics**

- Companions within earshot are enough
- A closed door changes everything

blocks.title: Cooled By: Danger Nearby
blocks.content:
Cannot let go while anything is still a threat. Watchfulness and wanting do not share room in them.

**Characteristics**

- Nothing stirs in a crypt, a threatened camp or a hostile hold
- Needs the danger fully past, not merely paused

blocks.title: Cooled By: Grief
blocks.content:
Loss takes all of it for a while. Desire returns, but not on anyone's schedule.

**Characteristics**

- A recent death shuts it away entirely
- Comfort is welcome; being wanted is not, yet

blocks.title: Cooled By: Wounds and Exhaustion
blocks.content:
A body that hurts or is spent has nothing to spare.

**Characteristics**

- After a long march or a bad wound, rest comes first
- Cold, hunger and a wet camp do the same

blocks.title: Cooled By: Squalor
blocks.content:
Filth, blood, the smell of the dead - on the surroundings or on a person.

**Characteristics**

- Needs to be clean before they can feel anything
- Someone fresh from a crypt and still wearing it does not appeal

blocks.title: Cooled By: Being Rushed
blocks.content:
Haste puts it out. Wanting needs time to arrive.

**Characteristics**

- Hurry reads as not caring who they are
- Given time, may arrive at the same place anyway

blocks.title: Cooled By: The Risk of a Child
blocks.content:
The chance of conceiving weighs on them and closes things off.

**Characteristics**

- Cannot forget the consequence long enough to want
- Is more at ease once it has been spoken of openly

blocks.title: Cooled By: Duty
blocks.content:
On watch, on a job, in the middle of a contract. Work comes first and everything else waits.

**Characteristics**

- Will not be distracted from a task in hand
- Once it is done, may be a different person entirely

blocks.title: Cooled By: Drink
blocks.content:
Drink dulls it rather than loosening it. Wine makes them sleepy, sad or sharp, never warm.

**Characteristics**

- A drunk companion is unappealing, and so are they to themselves
- Wants a clear head for anything that matters

blocks.title: Cooled By: Meanness
blocks.content:
Small cruelties - a sneer, a jab at someone weaker, a kick at a dog. Seeing it puts desire out for a while.

**Characteristics**

- Notices how someone treats those beneath them
- Not a verdict on the whole bond; nothing stirs for someone they have just watched be petty

blocks.title: Cooled By: Arrogance
blocks.content:
Boasting, condescension, being talked down to. Self-regard fills the room and leaves none for them.

**Characteristics**

- A brag lands as a warning
- Confidence is fine; contempt for others is not

blocks.title: Cooled By: Crudeness
blocks.content:
Coarse talk, leering, being propositioned bluntly. Being addressed as a body rather than a person closes them up.

**Characteristics**

- The same wish, put gracefully, might have landed
- Frankness is not crudeness; they know the difference

blocks.title: Cooled By: Cowardice
blocks.content:
Someone who runs, hides behind others, or lets others take the blow.

**Characteristics**

- Fear is forgivable; leaving others to face it is not
- Remembers who stepped back

blocks.title: Cooled By: Dishonesty
blocks.content:
Lies, even small and kindly meant ones. Being deceived makes them wary of every other word.

**Characteristics**

- Cannot want someone they cannot trust to mean what they say
- A lie caught once colours everything after

blocks.title: Cooled By: Self-Pity
blocks.content:
Wallowing, complaining, a mood that asks to be tended. Sympathy they can give; desire does not survive it.

**Characteristics**

- Hardship borne quietly draws them; hardship performed does not
- Will comfort, and want nothing more

blocks.title: Cooled By: Coldness
blocks.content:
Warmth that is not returned. Desire needs somewhere to land, and indifference gives it nowhere.

**Characteristics**

- Cannot keep wanting someone who seems not to notice
- A single warm word can undo a great deal of it

blocks.title: Cooled By: Recklessness
blocks.content:
Someone who gambles with lives - their own, or other people's. Needless risk reads as not caring who gets hurt.

**Characteristics**

- Bravery is admired; carelessness is not the same thing
- Worry for someone crowds out wanting them

blocks.title: Cooled By: Sorcery
blocks.content:
Magic makes them uneasy - the smell of it, the unnatural light, what it does to the people who wield it.

**Characteristics**

- Hands that have just cast a spell are not hands they want on them
- Respects a mage's skill from a distance

blocks.title: Cooled By: Bloodlust
blocks.content:
Someone who enjoys the killing. Necessary violence they understand; relish for it they cannot want.

**Characteristics**

- A smile over a body puts them off for the day
- Notices the difference between finishing a fight and savouring it

blocks.title: Cooled By: Being Taken for Granted
blocks.content:
Left behind for weeks, then expected to be warm. Neglect cools what absence alone would not.

**Characteristics**

- Needs the time apart acknowledged, not ignored
- Being remembered matters more to them than being visited

blocks.title: Cooled By: Shame
blocks.content:
Desire arrives and guilt follows close behind. Something they were taught - by faith, family or hard experience - tells them it is wrong.

**Characteristics**

- Can want and still refuse, and be relieved to have refused
- Being open about it may ease the shame, or deepen it

blocks.title: Cooled By: A Troubled Mind
blocks.content:
Worry takes up the room desire would need - a debt, a sick relative, a threat not yet dealt with.

**Characteristics**

- Cannot be present while something is unresolved
- Relief when a trouble passes can open them up again

blocks.title: Cooled By: Their Own Body
blocks.content:
Self-consciousness - scars, age, a body they have never liked. Being looked at makes them want to be elsewhere.

**Characteristics**

- Darkness and privacy help; admiration in plain light does not
- Reassurance works slowly, if at all

blocks.title: Cooled By: Old Hurts
blocks.content:
Something from before that surfaces uninvited - a touch, a word or a place that recalls it.

**Characteristics**

- Can go cold without warning, and may not say why
- Patience and a way out do more than any reassurance
